takes.note: The habit. A loops a six-beat circuit: into the nook behind the south-west pillar, a swing at nothing on beat 2 and another on beat 5. Once this is committed the Archivist files a strike on the nook every three beats, and three beats is exactly how long one memory keeps it busy.

The doorstop. B walks to the call plate and stands on it for the whole fight, which holds the stacks gate open. Standing still is the one thing the Archivist punishes, and it never gets round to B: A already owns every slot.

First blade. C waits at the gate for B, goes round into the stacks behind the desk and cuts at the Archivist's back for the rest of the tape, then the tape repeats and C does it all again. Every one of these swings is on file after this take; none is ever acted on, because A's beat always comes first.
Second blade. D does the same beside C. One blade cannot empty the bar inside the fight; two can, with about a bar to spare.

notes: Objective complete at beat 20.02: Close the Archivist's file.
Tape A died at beat 2: struck by boss archivist (remembering Tape A).
Survivors: Tape B, Tape C, Tape D.
